# The clerk proposes an intent that is not JSON in one case and an empty intent in another. Neither crashes the run. Each case goes to the exception queue
# with the reason code bad-intent, which goes to the procedure owner, and nothing is written or sent.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

deskinit
deskfakes
subst home/.desk/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env DESK_DIR=$WORK/desk

exec beehavereal item add desk shift-1 --title 'Morning shift' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run shift-1 desk --workflow desk/workflow.star
stdout 'item shift-1 finished'

! exists writes.log
! exists mail.out
! exists home/.desk/sent.tsv

exec beehavereal status
stdout 'shift-1-r1\tdone'
stdout 'item-desk-2-r1\tdone'
stdout 'item-desk-3-r1\tdone'

-- body.txt --
The morning shift.
-- home/.desk/config --
